q: How many dot-separated parts does a signed JWT have?

why: Reject tokens after exp (allowing small clock skew).

q: Why should client apps treat the token as opaque?
o: Only the verifying service should rely on its contents; the format may change

q: Decoding a JWT without verifying the signature is fine for access decisions.
why: Myth. Unverified claims can be forged; verify first.
